core_obligations: Derive flatness of the first map (proof lines 10513-10514).

proof_roadmap: Base change at a prime (proof lines 10515-10517).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that in a composition of ring maps, if the total map is regular and the middle map is flat and surjective on spectra, then the first map is regular. The proof first obtains flatness of the first map from the flatness permanence result. Then, at a prime of the base, the base change of the middle map along the residue field extension is again flat and surjective on spectra, so the base change of the fibre of the first map is geometrically regular by the corresponding descent statement for geometric regularity, which is the required condition.
